summary: Fusion Fuel Green PLC filed a Form 6-K on May 7, 2026, announcing selected financial results for FY2025 and a business update. The press release discusses strategic repositioning, including the planned acquisition of a portfolio of uranium and natural gas royalties from Royal Uranium Inc. No specific terms, such as price, premium, or advisor names, are disclosed. The filing is a routine earnings update with forward-looking statements; no abrupt management changes or definitive deal terms are provided. This is a standard report from a foreign private issuer. As a non-US filing, the 6-K is equivalent to a US Form 8-K.
